class RollbackDSU:
    def __init__(self, n={{n}}):
        self.p = list(range(n))
        self.sz = [1]*n
        self.hist = []
    def find(self, x):
        while self.p[x] != x: x = self.p[x]
        return x
    def union(self, a, b):
        a, b = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if a == b:
            self.hist.append(None); return False
        if self.sz[a] < self.sz[b]: a, b = b, a
        self.hist.append((b, self.sz[a]))
        self.p[b] = a
        self.sz[a] += self.sz[b]
        return True
    def undo(self):
        h = self.hist.pop()
        if h is None: return
        b, sa = h
        self.sz[self.p[b]] = sa
        self.p[b] = b
